description: Deterministic LLM outputs for question variant generation (QGEN-01, M6.0/M6.2). APP_ENV=test only: the worker's ScenarioLLMClient (book_core.llm.scenarios) picks the scenario whose marker occurs in the prompt (the source question's stem ends with ` [<marker>]`) and answers by task name; an unscripted task fails loudly. Outputs follow book_core.generation.LLMVariantBatch (questions.generate.*/v1: option labels, correct_option_labels, citations by passage tag). The worker's passages for a source citing book-ko.pdf p.4 are one per section on that page, in reading order: P1 = '2장 정수 처리' intro, P2 = '2.1 응집과 침전', P3 = '2.2 여과와 소독'.

mock_exam.description: Deterministic batched LLM outputs for mock exam generation (MOCK-01, MOCK.0). APP_ENV=test only; every assumption (prompt tags, fake behaviour, call recording, fault and hold tokens) is K4-K7 in tests/e2e/fixtures/mock-exams.ts and MOCK-B builds the fake from this block. One request = one batch of sources tagged S1..Sn, each with its variation type; each source stem ends with ` [<marker>]` and the fake answers one item per source of the request from `sources.<key>.items.<VARIATION_TYPE>` (or the `templates`), in request order, setting `source_tag` to the source's S tag and each citation's `passage_id` to the request's passage tag whose text contains the quote. The same request always gets the same answer (stateless), so a re-request of a failed item fails the same way. Passages come from the source's `sources` page of book-ko.pdf (p.2: chapter 1, p.4: chapter 2); every quote of an item meant to pass occurs verbatim on that page. `chapter` is the outline chapter (1: '1장 물의 순환', 2: '2장 정수 처리', null: no chapter) the tests file the source under.

faults.malformed: A request with more than `sources_over` sources that carries this source gets raw output that is not JSON (cut mid-string); stop_reason end_turn. Smaller requests are answered normally, so halving the batch recovers every item.
faults.truncated: Like `malformed`, but the raw output is a valid JSON prefix cut mid-item and the call info says stop_reason max_tokens with output_tokens = the request's output budget (an answer cut at MOCK_EXAM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS).
faults.unavailable: Every request that carries this source raises LLMProviderError(kind='unavailable') (no output); the generation fails with llm_unavailable.

crash.description: Checkpoint test (C09-6): marker E2E-MOCK-CRASH-<token> (16 hex). The first request carrying a token creates `<WORKER_MOCK_EXAM_FAULT_DIR>/<token>.crashed` and raises MockExamSimulatedCrash (a BaseException, so the job is left running like a killed worker); later requests (the file exists) answer like a bulk source would (its own item). Chapter 2, page 4, so it packs after the bulk sources.

hold.description: E2E hold barrier (K6): a source stem that also carries [E2E-MOCK-HOLD-<token>] (16 hex) makes the fake, when a request carries it, create `<WORKER_MOCK_EXAM_HOLD_DIR>/<token>.held` and wait (at most 120 s) until `<token>.release` exists (immediately when it already does), so 'n개 중 k개' is observable with a fake that otherwise answers in milliseconds.
